home.heroTitle: Early Detection & Management of Crop Diseases and Pest Infestations
home.heroSubtitle: An integrated crop-health intelligence system combining image-based AI symptom identification, pheromone trap & IoT sensor inputs, microclimate forecasting, geospatial hotspot surveillance, and KVK expert validation.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need, in one place
home.featuresSubtitle: From diagnosis to harvest — practical guidance designed for Indian farming conditions.
home.feature1Desc: Answer a few questions about what you see on your plants and get likely disease matches with confidence scores.
home.feature2Desc: Step-by-step organic and chemical treatments, with dosages suited to Indian market products.
home.feature3Desc: Month-by-month guidance on what diseases to watch for based on your crop and region.
home.feature4Desc: Install as an app and use in the field without internet. Built for low-connectivity areas.
home.cropsSubtitle: Diagnostic profiles for major staple & cash crops grown across Western Maharashtra, Marathwada, Vidarbha, and Konkan.
home.ctaTitle: Protect Your Crop Before Symptoms Spread
home.ctaSubtitle: Start by selecting a crop, uploading a leaf photo, or testing our sample field library to receive instant CIBRC-compliant IPM management steps.
home.greeting: Welcome to Kshetrikah — Crop Health & Integrated Pest Defense System
home.radarYavatmal: Yavatmal: Cotton Pink Bollworm (14 moths/trap — ETL Breached)
home.radarNashik: Nashik: Grape Downy Mildew (8.2h Leaf Wetness — Spore Risk)
home.modulesSubtitle: Engineered by TEAM BITHEADS to solve delayed detection, lab shortages, and inappropriate pesticide use across Maharashtra farming communities.
home.module1Desc: Visual bounding box overlays detecting fungal leaf lesions, viral yellow mosaic, and pest boring holes with confidence scores and 1-click test photos.
home.module2Desc: Pheromone trap counts for Pink Bollworm & FAW with Economic Threshold Level (ETL) triggers, leaf wetness hours, and spore germination algorithms.
home.module3Desc: Interactive GIS outbreak maps of Maharashtra showing active cluster densities, quarantine containment perimeters, and taluka risk indexes.
home.module4Desc: Connect directly with Krishi Vigyan Kendras and state agriculture universities for specimen validation, lab diagnosis referral, and audio notes.
home.module5Desc: Command dashboard for taluka extension officers to monitor district league tables and broadcast SMS/WhatsApp emergency alerts to farmers.
home.module6Desc: Structured post-treatment recovery tracking timeline where farmers log outcome photos to continuously refine the diagnostic engine.
home.safeSubtitle: Our management engine enforces strict Integrated Pest Management (IPM) guidelines. Chemical interventions are suggested only after Economic Threshold Levels (ETL) are breached, paired with Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI) and mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE).
home.safePhi: Strict PHI Enforcement (Pre-harvest interval residue safety)

about.title: About क्षेत्रिकः (Kshetrikah)
about.subtitle: A free, open resource for India's farmers.
about.missionBody: Indian farmers lose an estimated 15–25% of their crops to pests and diseases every year. Most of these losses are preventable with timely identification and the right treatment. क्षेत्रिकः (Kshetrikah) puts expert knowledge in your pocket — for free, in your language, and works offline.
about.disclaimerBody: The treatments recommended here are general guidelines. Disease identification is based on a symptom checklist — for accurate diagnosis and pesticide recommendations, consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agricultural extension officer. Always follow product labels when using any pesticide.
